::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 209,536 people lived in County Limerick, up 7.5% on 2016. It had the 6th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 63% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Limerick was €1,619, the 5th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
